name: Moonbag (early entry, free bag)
description: An early entry on a young pair. At about 2x, sell the slice whose proceeds pay back the whole position cost; the rest rides as a free bag with a loose 55% trail off its peak and the thesis-break exits only. No hard stop, so the size is small: early entries rug often.

fit.summary: A young pair (0-2 h) with an early clean push that has not gone vertical yet, liquidity >= $20k, and the holder-safety gates clean (no mint or freeze authority, top-10 <= 30%, dev <= 5%).
signals: first clean 5m push with buyers ahead of sellers
many distinct buyers, top-2 share low

hardStop.why: Young pairs shake out 30-60% before a real run, and a rug fills near -100% whatever stop is set. The protection is the small size, the safety gates at entry and the thesis breaks.

reentry.requires: one entry per coin: an early entry cannot be repeated late

notes: The bag trail arms on the cost-recovery sell, not on a gain; before that only the thesis breaks and the rug floor can exit.
tighten on a free bag halves its trail (never below 10%); a bag trail is never loosened by an agent.
